topic: Definition of corrosion on steel products, aluminum and magnesium alloys and copper alloys.
syllabus_extract: Definition of corrosion on steel products, aluminum and magnesium alloys and copper alloys.
specific_objectives: 6.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe types of corrosion.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of corrosion definitions on steel, aluminum, magnesium, and copper alloys; Instructor supervision required for material handling safety.
intro_questions: What is the general definition of corrosion?
Which metals are most susceptible to corrosion in aircraft?
Why is understanding corrosion important for aircrew?

development.content:
General definition of corrosion
Chemical process of oxidation
Environmental factors causing corrosion
Impact on aircraft structural integrity
Basic prevention concepts

Corrosion mechanisms in steel products
Corrosion mechanisms in aluminum alloys
Corrosion mechanisms in magnesium alloys
Corrosion mechanisms in copper alloys
Differences in alloy susceptibility

Classification of corrosion types
Galvanic corrosion basics
Electrochemical cell formation
Role of electrolytes in corrosion
Initial identification of corrosion signs

summary_questions: Define corrosion specifically for magnesium alloys.
Explain how an electrolyte contributes to the corrosion process.
Differentiate between corrosion types in steel versus aluminum.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific corrosion risks associated with copper alloys in aircraft systems, referencing the definitions learned in this lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Various types of corrosion and their identification.
